# Copilot instructions
Follow the root AGENTS.md and docs/MAINTAINER_GUIDE.md.

Maintain one C# application authority and one React frontend. Do not add a Go backend, standalone calculator, parallel demo or second workflow authority. Preserve original reference features inside the shared application.

When integrating into another repository's established ports/adapters framework, preserve that framework and its policies. Map responsibilities and contracts; do not overwrite its bootstrap, CI, AGENTS.md or architecture. Carry tests with each slice and keep employer data out of public source.

Preserve synthetic-only boundaries, immutable history, assessment-scoped authorization, independent review, explicit Phase 1 selection and honest evidence status. Never infer enterprise acceptance or remediation authority from demo success.
